name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task says 'you must have flipped the switch first', an 'only after' order, but the candidate has only hard Existence(at_exit). The compiled machine confirms this: its single transition (u0, at_exit) -> u1 pays reward for reaching the exit with no condition on switch_toggled, so the agent can reach the exit without ever flipping the switch and still finish. Add a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit); together with Existence(at_exit) it forces the switch to be flipped before the exit, so no Existence(switch_toggled) is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) captures the commanded 'Reach the exit', and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) captures 'you must have flipped the switch first', banning at_exit before the first switch_toggled. Together the two hard clauses force the switch flip, so no Existence(switch_toggled) is needed; the clauses, priorities, and argument order all match the task.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
